name: manual_46e563
claim: In a frontend worktree, resolve missing dev types with a worktree-local frozen install using the CI package-manager major before changing the manifest or weakening type checks.

decisions.notes: Orama #534 at a09c81eb already declared Node types. Its borrowed dependency tree lacked them, pnpm 11 did not match the build-script policy, and a clean pnpm 10.26.0 frozen install restored the pinned dependency without lockfile changes.
